title: Classes: A Bank Account
learning_objectives: Define a class with __init__, attributes and methods
Protect an object's state by validating in methods
Distinguish class attributes from instance attributes
hints: Create `self.history = []` in `__init__` and check the start balance there.
In `withdraw`, raise before changing anything: `if amount <= 0 or amount > self.balance: raise ValueError(...)`.
`transfer_to` can call `self.withdraw(amount)` then `other.deposit(amount)`; `!r` in an f-string adds quotes.

failure_feedback.advice: Raise ValueError before modifying balance or history.
Do not make `history` a class attribute; create it in `__init__`.
Withdraw first; if it raises, the deposit never happens.
Define `interest_rate = 0.02` in the class body and deposit the rounded interest.
